text_blocks.snippet: The COVID-19 pandemic led to a significant loss of jobs in the United States. Total nonfarm employment fell by 1.4 million in March 2020 and a further 20.5 million in April, creating a 22 million job deficit compared to pre-pandemic levels, according to the Center on Budget and Policy Priorities. While there were job gains in most months following the initial drop, it took time to recover the lost ground. State and local government employment also declined, with elementary and secondary education experiencing the largest job losses.
